name: Writing desk
description: A scholar's oak writing desk about 1.2 × 0.6 m with its top at 0.76 m: plank top, four legs with a stretcher frame, a shallow drawer with an iron ring pull and a low rail along the back. On it lie sheets of written parchment, a half unrolled scroll, a closed book, a dark glass inkwell with a quill leaning in it and a tallow candle in an iron dish.
